description: Find the 5-character UN/LOCODE of a seaport, airport or inland container depot by place name (or check a code): returns code, name, country, subdivision, type and Triplicate's country page, for the port of loading or discharge on bookings, bills of lading and invoices. UN/LOCODE 2025-1, 37,000+ places.

country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code to search in, e.g. 'VN'

query.description: Port, city or airport name in English (e.g. 'Haiphong', 'Jebel Ali', 'Busan'), or a 5-character UN/LOCODE (e.g. 'NLRTM')

type.description: Optional: only seaports, airports or inland container depots

name: lookup_port_code
title: Look up UN/LOCODE port codes
